hook.name: ExponentialLiquidityHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook for newly deployed ERC20 tokens that distributes liquidity exponentially across multiple tick ranges. In afterSwap, it collects a 1% fee from swaps (returned via afterSwapReturnsDelta) and removes all pool liquidity when the token supply threshold of 10,000 tokens is reached, graduating the token from the bonding curve phase.
